topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: The young scholar who learned alongside me, I fear he's tumbled into a deep well of trouble. They say he took words not his own and called them his. It's a heavy weight, such a thing, and I worry for his standing and his soul. The priest speaks often of honesty and the trust we hold as sacred. When I hold the earth in my hands, I know it yields nothing without honest toil. I've seen the lad, lost in the scrolls and books, and I pray he finds a way to set his footsteps back on the straight path. May the saints guide him, as they guide us all, to the light of truth.
